title: Token Detail Record (TDR) — The Method For Token Spending Accountability
excerpt: The public definition of the Token Detail Record: a durable transaction record describing one completed AI inference event, preserving what is needed to identify, attribute, measure, rate, correlate and audit it. Covers why an atomic record is needed, the information classes within a TDR, the three sources of truth that must remain distinct, TDRs in agentic systems, and the term's lineage from telecom's Call Detail Record. Companion to the AGU-TDR-001 Foundation Specification.

title: Token Detail Record — Mediation Output Specification (AGU-TDR-001)
excerpt: The companion engineering specification to the Accountability Framework: the normative definition of the Token Detail Record as emitted by the AgentU Proxy of Record. Issue 1, record format 1.7. Specifies record generation and structure, the 55-field record layout, file organisation and archive naming, two-stage delivery, exception handling, and conformance requirements for consuming systems.

title: The Enterprise AI Accountability Framework
excerpt: The accounting plane for enterprise AI. Introduces the Token Detail Record (TDR), the heir to telecom's Call Detail Record, and the Proxy of Record (POR): an independent, per-event, rated ledger of AI consumption you can reconcile against the vendor invoice, govern, and prove.

title: The Agent Control Plane
excerpt: The signaling plane for enterprise AI. Treats dispersed specialized agents as a network, not a function call, and adapts telecom's control and data plane split (ASP, ALS, ABC, Agent Bearer, SigMod) to establish, route, negotiate, and govern agent sessions.
